listings.remarks: Sunken Living Room Studio in a 1939 Art Deco Building | Bedford Park  Welcome to Apartment 3G at 2962 Decatur Avenue, a renovated studio co-op in Bedford Park designed around a sunken living room. The home is in a boutique prewar elevator building from about 1939, with a live-in superintendent and an on-site laundry room.
